result.keywords: This paper examines archival techniques for mapping intertidal migrations of luminous plankton using hand-drawn grids, salt-stained metadata, and chronicle-based indexing. We propose a fictional cartographic workflow for reconciling tide tables, harbor legends, and lantern observations into a coherent seasonal ledger. Case notes from three coastal observatories are used to illustrate the method, with emphasis on narrative provenance rather than automated sensing.
result.title: Nocturne Ledger for Tidal Cartography.
